title: Non-Review-Notice Disposition Plan
description: Dry-run plan or apply result for auto-dispositioning advisory non-review notices and the CodeRabbit summary walkthrough on a PR (E6 PATH B).

mode.description: Whether this document is a disposition plan or the result of applying it.

prNumber.description: Pull request whose non-review notices were classified.

headSha.description: PR head SHA to which the disposition plan or result is bound.

planned.description: Notices or CodeRabbit summary walkthroughs selected for disposition and the response planned for each one.

noticeId.description: GitHub comment identifier of the notice or summary walkthrough.

botLogin.description: Bot login associated with the notice or summary walkthrough.

reason.description: Reason the notice or summary walkthrough is eligible for the planned disposition.

body.description: Rendered disposition body beginning with the Accepted or Rejected decision.

status.description: Outcome of an apply-mode disposition attempt.

applied.description: Notices or summary walkthroughs whose disposition was posted successfully in apply mode.

noticeId.description: GitHub comment identifier of the successfully handled notice or summary walkthrough.

commentId.description: Identifier of the disposition comment created by the apply operation.

failed.description: Notices or summary walkthroughs whose disposition could not be applied, with the reported error.

noticeId.description: GitHub comment identifier of the notice or summary walkthrough that failed.

error.description: Error reported while applying the disposition.

skipped.description: Notices or summary walkthroughs intentionally left unchanged by the disposition route.

noticeId.description: GitHub comment identifier of the skipped notice or summary walkthrough.

botLogin.description: Bot login associated with the skipped notice or summary walkthrough.

reason.description: Reason the notice or summary walkthrough was not selected for disposition.
